items.html:
Shafiq Sharif is a wicketkeeper whose hero is Adam Gilchrist. He has played for Malaysia's senior team and represents the Negeri Semblian Senior State Side. His ambition is to play for Malaysia at the World Cup.
Cricinfo staff February 2008
